Left, upper and right fruit groups ripen progressively without an established red fruit turning green again. Yellow blossoms remain beside the upper pair through the finish.

The mature result retains the richer original target's defining arrangement: three left fruit, four right fruit, two upper fruit, yellow blossoms, serrated layered foliage and a broad bean base. It is a regenerated interpretation of that composition, not an assertion of identical final-frame pixels.
All row boundaries retain coherent growth and registration. No blocking transparency holes, edge clipping, detached fragments or theme contrast problem was found.
